acceptance_scope_coordination.separate_reconstruction_scope: The same commit also adds keyless-domain and nullable-key reconstruction across modes; passing spilling profiles may exercise that expanded reconstruction scope.
acceptance_scope_coordination.shared_statement: A source-level explanation and passing bounded rows do not convert absent reducer/input lineage evidence into full proof. Acceptance-scope assessment of the actual production diff remains separate.
acceptance_scope_coordination.stage_order_change: The new earlier inlining stage is restricted to no-channel-spilling mode.

established_facts: The previously unclassified wrapper is WideFromBlocks in all observed projected branches.
All observed NarrowMap structure values are exact references to their own two scalar lambda arguments; output names and source arguments form a local bijection.
Only the direct identity branch is shown to return the exact Switch branch argument. The projected branch input chain stops at DqPhyHashCombine.
The float profile has one projected branch and one identity branch; the integer profile has three projected branches across two switches and one identity branch.
Both bounded executions pass their existing semantic and structural oracles, guard and binary-provenance checks. They retain false full-lineage flags.
main_conclusion: The actual outer projection is now characterized, but the observations do not support extending complete shared-value lineage proof. Every projected branch reaches a DqPhyHashCombine boundary before the observer reaches the Switch branch input.

narrow_lineage_support_decision.conditional_source_supported_rule: Only an exact key-only reducer with direct distinct input-key arguments, empty init/update state, a complete key-only finish permutation, validated block layout, exact branch-input identity and the existing exact-scalar-domain precondition could preserve the required domain field provenance. Current counters do not establish those conditions.

ydb/core/kqp/opt/rbo/kqp_rbo_transformer.role: The earlier inlining stage is added only when channel spilling is disabled.

ydb/core/kqp/opt/rbo/physical_conversion.role: Aggregate lowering invokes TransformStageOutput with GetReplicateOutputIndex.
All aggregates use the same block transport and NarrowMap projection envelope; key/init/update/finish lambdas determine whether output is keys or aggregate state.
The actual new-RBO aggregation builder directly names DqPhyHashCombine.
TransformStageOutput applies aggregation to one selected Switch branch while preserving the others.

ydb/core/kqp/opt/rbo/rules/decorrelation.role: MakeDomainProjection is key-only grouping with no aggregation traits and retained key identities.

ydb/core/kqp/opt/rbo/rules/inline_join_f.role: Shared producer ports and optional key-only domain are distinct from aggregate state generation; domain reconstruction is introduced when key metadata is empty.

ydb/core/kqp/opt/rbo/rules/propagate_agg.role: Aggregation over a replicate port can be pushed into the producer stage; operator kind is not a source-read barrier.

ydb/library/yql/dq/type_ann/dq_type_ann..role: Hash-combine output is derived from finish-handler output; block output includes an auxiliary row-count scalar.

yql/essentials/core/type_ann/type_ann_bl.role: WideFromBlocks removes the block row-count component; it is not a literal unchanged-width row-layout wrapper.

source_interpretation: The new-RBO physical aggregation builder itself emits the exact observed FromFlow/NarrowMap/ToFlow/WideFromBlocks/FromFlow/DqPhyHashCombine envelope when blocks are enabled.
That envelope is shared by key-only grouping and stateful aggregation. The local NarrowMap bijection preserves reducer output positions; it does not identify those values with the reducer inputs.
Aggregate stage propagation and TransformStageOutput explain why the reduction can occur inside a Switch branch. This is compatible with the source pipeline and is not by itself a production bug.

MakeDomainProjection has empty aggregation traits and retained key identities, so a narrowly bounded proof could recognize that exact reducer form if its actual key/init/update/finish lambdas and input identity were available.
Stateful reductions require different reasoning. Reclassifying DqPhyHashCombine as a transparent projection would be unsound.
